high_level_description: The image shows two women taking a selfie in front of a large mirror with built-in lighting. The mirror is framed by vertical light bars on either side, which appear to be part of the mirror's design, providing illumination for the photo. The woman on the left has long, dark hair and is wearing a beige sleeveless crop top paired with black pants that have a textured pattern. She is holding a smartphone in her right hand, which she uses to take the selfie. Her left hand is resting on her thigh, and she appears to be wearing a bracelet on her left wrist.
